verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat product with voice huddles, so screen sharing during a call is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows voice huddles ("drop into voice huddles", relay hosting "huddle audio") and calls of "1:1 and group. Up to 9." Nothing in the pack documents screen sharing, and the video playback with frame-anchored comments is a different feature.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration
